whenToUse: The end-of-page call to action: Get a quote, Book a table, Start a trial.
Newsletter signup or a booking bar for appointments and reservations.
avoidWhen: Several competing CTAs on one page — one primary per page.
In-app prompts — use Empty state or Alert.
a11y: The heading states the offer; the button text is specific (Book a table, not Submit).
Newsletter inputs have labels, not only placeholders.
